Time a query, log its shape, and re-raise any error

Source: R/analytics.R
ms_track_query.Rd

Wraps an expression so the Sheet records how long it took, how many rows it returned, and whether it failed — in the dedicated ms / n_rows / status / error columns, which stay numeric and chartable rather than being buried in the params JSON.

Usage

ms_track_query(session, event, params = list(), expr)

Arguments

session

the Shiny session object

event

event name, passed to ms_event()

params

named list of event parameters

expr

the expression to time

Value

whatever expr returns

Details

The result passes through untouched (including a lazy dbplyr table, whose row count is deliberately NOT forced), and an error is re-raised after being logged, so wrapping a call never changes behaviour.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
d <- ms_track_query(session, "download_species_csv", list(area = hdr),
                    species_for_zone(con, "programarea_key", key))
} # }
